verdict.rationale: Base44's 'eject' command only clones an app into a new Base44-hosted project with its own app ID (base44-docs-1/22), and custom-domain support (base44-docs-8/26) is for pointing a domain at Base44's own hosting, not exporting to external infrastructure. No evidence describes downloading a deployable build for self-hosting or deploying to a third-party cloud/host.
